{{Color|Legendary}} |music-1 = [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Metaverse (Giga AJ)|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|The world's deadliest mercenaries are available for hire!.. for a hefty price!|Shop Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Phantom Crate''' is a crate which has nine skins in total, which are meant to be mercenaries. Each skin that can be gotten from the '''Phantom Crate''' has a rarity which affects how likely you are to unlock the skin and the price when it appears in the daily skin store. In the daily skin store, {{Color|Common}} skins cost {{Robux|199}}, {{Color|Uncommon}} skins {{Robux|249}}, {{Color|Rare}} skins cost {{Robux|349}} and {{Color|Legendary}} skins cost {{Robux|499}}. ==Appearance== The '''Phantom Crate''' is a dark grey and red crate with a neon blue emblem. On the side, it has a lock which when turned unlocks the crate. It is opened from the top. ==Methods of Obtaining== ===Current Methods=== #Purchasable in the store for {{Robux|200}}. ===Former Methods=== #Rank 9 and 13 of [[Krampus' Revenge Event#Krampus' Revenge Season Pass|Krampus' Revenge Season]]. #Chance to appear as the reward for [[Quests#Damage Dealer|Damage Dealer]] weekly quests with a 4,000,000 damage requirement. #*This quest could appear multiple times. ==Skins== {| class="light-table align-center pad-5" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" {{!}}Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" {{!}}Description {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:PhantomSkincrateOpen.ogg]] {{!}}Opening sound effect {{!}}} }} ==Trivia== *The skins made for this crate were made years before it would actually get added. **While some of the skins like the {{Color|Phantom|Phantom}} [[Commander]] mostly remained unchanged, other skins like the {{Color|Phantom|Phantom}} [[Gladiator]] received massive changes in comparison to the versions teased years ago. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Phantom Crate''' added. *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|250}} to {{Robux|200}}. *'''15 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.5|v1.27.9]] **'''Phantom Crate''' cannot be purchased with {{Robux|Robux}} in the Netherlands, Belgium and the United Kingdom (the latter only for players under the age of 18). ***{{Bug}} '''Phantom Crate''' can still be purchased with {{Robux|Robux}} in the [[Daily Store]]. *'''20 September 2024''' - [[v1.32.0|v1.32.2b]] **'''Phantom Crate''' cannot be purchased with {{Robux|Robux}} in Australia. *'''2 July 2025''' - [[v1.69.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Geo-restriction can no longer be bypassed in the [[Daily Store]]. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Icon added. **Crate opening music added. *'''21 August 2026''' - [[v2.7.0]] **{{Color|Legendary}} rarity added. **Added [[Daily Store]] prices for skins. ***{{Color|Common}} skins cost {{Robux|199}}. ***{{Color|Uncommon}} skins cost {{Robux|249}}. ***{{Color|Rare}} skins cost {{Robux|349}}. ***{{Color|Legendary}} skins cost {{Robux|499}}. {{CrateNavBox}}
